Retail round 4: variants and planted distractors

328 products. One document per style: every color × size it is sold in is a SKU nested in it, and its color swatches and size options are derived from those SKUs. Jeans and bras are deep (crossed, rule-bound axes); bedding and beauty are shallow (one hand list per row). Every brand, line and shade name is invented.
